name: Linkage Global Inc.
summary: Linkage Global Inc. functions as a holding company, primarily focused on delivering comprehensive e-commerce solutions for international transactions. Leveraging its various operating subsidiaries, the company has developed an extensive service framework. This system encompasses two mutually supportive core business segments: global sales operations and holistic e-commerce support services. Its commercial activities are structured across the 'Extend' and 'Other Subsidiaries' divisions. Linkage Global Inc. was established on March 24, 2022, and maintains its principal corporate office in Tokyo, Japan.
